instrument: SNTS Style track (clone) / Kick (G) / kHs Transient Shaper / Attack
hypothesis: Single-variable rig: on Kick (G) only the kHs Transient Shaper (VST) is enabled; Decapitator is bypassed; Drum Rack (instrument) and Utility (gain-only, gain-invariant) stay as-is. Attack is the transient/attack-gain knob (default 0.7796). Raising Attack should boost the kick's initial transient relative to its body, so crest (peak/RMS) is expected to INCREASE across 0..1. Real knobs are often non-monotonic, so the full min..max range is swept in 11 steps rather than just endpoints. Crest and sub_share are gain-invariant, so the post-mixer stereo tap is valid. The empirical curve settles it.
